I would like to see something with a "tree" style storyline, where you gain or lose access to certain things depending on who your friends and enemies are. And instead of requiring someone to maintain fully loyal to a specific storyline or faction, they can choose to say switch sides against a faction for an ethical or other decision and face the consequences of doing so. Many different endings would be present (some favorable to specific factions, some good, some so-so, some bad) and when you are headed for a certain type of ending, you will see the consequences start happening around you. For example if you are heading towards a bad ending, you can have an increasingly depressing story with friends either getting killed or turning against you and the world around you heading in a very negative direction with increasingly desperate and hopeless circumstances. For an ending favorable to a specific faction, you could see another faction slowly bleed out with the consequences associated with that (loss of access to shops, friends who are even loosely associated with them getting killed). The worst ending possible could be that you manage to turn everyone surviving against you and you pretty much become an outcast while the rest of the world goes to hell and the best ending being the hardest to get, that you unite all of the factions. And perhaps some decent endings where you unite most of the factions or have reasonably good ends under a certain really powerful factions. Bringing in time travelers would be another interesting element where they can give you hints as to what can happen but also have their own hidden agendas and not be entirely honest, or even try to interfere with things themselves. A so-so ending could be to preserve the timeline. You can go between different branches of a storyline but this is harder to do the further you get into the game. All factions will have a good amount of evil and hidden agendas behind them, as is increasingly revealed as you play through. For example, a seemingly democratic faction could have a mastermind who rigs elections in favor of increasing their own power while they kill anyone who gets in their way. Or rebels fighting against tyranny could be revealed by a person from the future as being a "North Korea on steroids" in their time. It would have an open world, but again with things gained and lost as you go into specific branches of the story. And some really loveable characters could drag you into a direction you may or may not want to go, or be eliminated if heading towards a bad ending or as a part of certain story branches which don't favor them or their faction.
